scope: Independent read-only review of root logistics integration

evidence.type: real DOM handlers with local adapter

scenarios: A visible row absent from native scoped options is unavailable and cannot trigger an edit
Accented multi-term search and identical names preserve exact selected ID
An unavailable saved destination remains visible without silently clearing the value
An option removed after rendering is rejected by the old card handler
Explicit eligible selection emits exactly one native change

review_conclusions: Search and clear-search are presentation-only: they do not mutate native field or dispatch change.
Existing native option and disabled/optgroup status are checked at selection time; no permissions, endpoint, request body or draft schema changed.
Rows and source names are built with textContent; no HTML interpretation of equipment names or paths.
Localized headings and group labels preserve existing controls and their event handlers; presentation module issues no API request or storage write.
Selected/unavailable state has visible text as well as aria-pressed/disabled; keyboard traversal skips unavailable buttons.
Header translation map preserves planning-versus-event and document-register-versus-approval distinctions.
limitations: No real browser, native keyboard engine, mobile layout, screen reader, network or production test was performed.
Headings were reviewed in source against the prior release; the 74 executed assertions above cover the actual picker handlers, not every heading layout.
Server ACL is authoritative and unchanged; this review does not replace the final integrated regression run.
test_only_addition: tests/test_ui138_logistics_independent.cjs added at root request; no product edits for review
